# Dolgachev–Shimada 15-nodal quartic data

Official supplement for *15-nodal quartic surfaces. Part II: The automorphism
group*: [arXiv 1908.05390](https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.05390),
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s12215-019-00464-7). Retrieved on 2026-08-06.

| `15nodalcompdata.txt` | `413d7363faf4574595e9c28329737eb4ad8010e0aebae53afb76762ce9f8966a` |
| `15nodalCompData.pdf` | `bdbcad07b4854d1d7992455523a2924aaf74d0cc2d80887a3f6a297f1e69daad` |

The rank 16 `GramS15`, 314 wall records `D15WallRecs`, and `OS15D15`/
`OS15D15permutation` describe the published induced chamber and its S6 action.
They are not an independent classification of all chambers.
